canada.title: Legislative standards commissioner revises fisheries minister’s disclosure filing after controversy
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador’s legislative standards commissioner, Ann Chafe, confirms she’s updating the public disclosure filing made by the province’s fisheries minister following a controversial two-night study tour in Scotland paid for by aquaculture giant MOWI.

canada.title: Electronic monitoring ordered for Canadian suspect in Belgian spy case
canada.summary: OTTAWA - The Belgian federal prosecutor's office says a Canadian facing espionage allegations has been ordered to remain in detention under electronic monitoring, not behind bars.

canada.title: Manitoba Possible opens doors to 'truly transformative' space in Winnipeg
canada.summary: A Manitoba disability services organization has created what it calls a new benchmark for how community spaces, public buildings and workplaces should be built.

canada.title: 'When will rural Manitoba matter?': Southwestern leader pleads for health-care improvements
canada.summary: Melita deputy mayor Camiel Serruys implored Manitoba's government to do more to address the health-care crisis in his community, during a bear-pit session at the start of the fall convention of the Association of Manitoba Municipalities.

canada.title: Sask. budget deficit shrinks to $784M in mid-year update
canada.summary: Finance Minister Jim Reiter says the fiscal update shows Saskatchewan remains resilient in the face of global uncertainty and market volatility.

canada.title: Edmonton’s football resurgence continues as city is announced as 2028 Grey Cup host
canada.summary: The Edmonton Elks and the Canadian Football League announced that the 2028 Grey Cup will be held in Edmonton. The last time Commonwealth Stadium hosted a Grey Cup was in 2018, when the Calgary Stampeders beat the Ottawa Redblacks 27-16.

canada.title: Teen allegedly wielding BB gun faces 7 charges after downtown Moncton police shooting
canada.summary: A 17-year-old faces new charges tied to a dramatic police shooting in downtown Moncton.

canada.title: Driver in 2025 crash that killed father of 3 sentenced to 6.5 years
canada.summary: A driver in a head-on crash that killed a father of three last year and prompted the Ontario government to introduce tougher dangerous driving penalties has been sentenced to six years and six months behind bars.
canada.outlet: CBC News + CityNews + Global News + CP24

canada.title: Man dead after shooting, attempted home invasion in midtown Toronto: police
canada.summary: A man has died after a shooting during an attempted home invasion early Wednesday in Toronto, police say. They said an unknown number of suspects 'forced their way' into a home and shot a resident during a confrontation.

canada.title: Quebec fugitive on Canada's most wanted list arrested in Ontario
canada.summary: The 19-year-old suspect, who was the subject of a Canada-wide arrest warrant, was arrested by the London Police Service in Ontario on Tuesday.

canada.title: 3rd former Montreal police officer arrested and charged in connection with racism scandal
canada.summary: A third former Montreal police officer has been charged in connection with the racism scandal at Station 39 in the Montréal-Nord borough. Last Saturday, two other former officers were arrested and charged.

canada.title: After torturing victim over missing drugs, Saskatoon man played VLTs, stabbed a stranger
canada.summary: Within hours of participating in a brutally violent homicide, Dillon Singler went out and played some VLTs at Market Mall in Saskatoon, where he randomly attacked and stabbed another man.

canada.title: N.L. is pausing plans to bring in flavoured vape ban
canada.summary: The government of Newfoundland and Labrador says it's postponing plans to amend the Tobacco and Vapour Products Control Act.

canada.title: King tides coincide with storms across coastal B.C. as evacuation alerts issued
canada.summary: Many coastal communities of B.C. are preparing with sandbags and clearing debris as a king tide coincides with waves of heavy rain and wind on Wednesday.

canada.title: Nova Scotia launches Support Our Troops licence plate benefiting military charity
canada.summary: Nova Scotia has unveiled a new Support our Troops specialty licence plate, with a $50 fee collected going to a charity that supports serving and former military members.

canada.title: ATCO blames Yukon billing issues on low estimates amid high heat use
canada.summary: An ATCO Electric Yukon executive told MLAs he's confident their billing systems are accurate — while an ongoing independent review examines low estimates made during Yukon's historic cold snap last winter.

canada.title: Nanaimo-area teacher banned for life after pleading guilty to possessing child sexual abuse material
canada.summary: Darrell Christopher Gilkes pleaded guilty to one count of possessing child sexual abuse material in April 2025. He was an on-call teacher in School District 68 (Nanaimo-Ladysmith) at the time of the offences.

canada.title: Former Alberta justice minister Kaycee Madu cleared of professional misconduct
canada.summary: Kaycee Madu has had his professional misconduct finding quashed in a case that accused him of calling Edmonton's police chief to get out of a distracted driving ticket.
